verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the reverse direction: Cekura ships an MCP server and Skills so external AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor and others) can drive Cekura. Nothing shows Cekura itself acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Its mock tools auto-fetch tool configurations from voice providers (VAPI, Retell, ElevenLabs, Bland), which is an adjacent feature, not MCP-server plug-in support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
